constraints: Test AHC booking state machine rules. Dates must respect: 4 days in advance, Mon-Sat only, no past/today dates. Use testdata for valid values.
manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
name: AHC edge - date without year accepted (assumes current year)
goal: Verify bot accepts 'Apr 5' or '5 Apr' without a year and assumes current year

phases.description: Enter a date without year like '22 May' (in current month or next month, at least 7 days out)
phases.completionCriteria: Bot accepts the date (assuming current year) and proceeds to ask for mobile number
phases.recoveryHint: If rejected as past/too soon, try a later month like '22 Jun'

phases.description: Complete the rest of the booking
